source_manifest.resume_policy: Retain all 107 prior HTTP 200 outputs as immutable prior inputs and exclude their IDs from requests. Re-request exactly the 36 previously terminal HTTP 400 rows and all 1905 originally unseen rows, preserving original source order, IDs, groups, splits, states, questions, options, labels and row bytes. Apply choice_enum_policy=omit to every resumed request as the tested request-shape change; strict local choice/confidence validation remains unchanged. Original HTTP 400 receipts are linked by request/response hashes below.

source_quality_holds.merge_semantics: Canonical holds are always applied before strict-label eligibility; each held source ID is rejected regardless of annotation match.

execution_component_verification.verification: all archived payloads match their immutable manifest pins; live-execution components also match current source bytes

transformations: Probability-contract rows retain raw probability receipts, use argmax (first declared option wins ties), and pass existing scoreGraded gates without normalization. Choice-label-confidence rows retain choice and bounded confidence as separate typed values, create no probability distribution, and pass only when choice exactly matches the source annotation. Binary noul uses p>=0.5. Gold annotations stay out of model-facing files and prompts.

criteria_provenance.source: explicit source criteria wins after exact label-key validation; otherwise the shared versioned family task contract is applied when declared; generated label-identity maps are omitted and options/levels define the answer domain

source_quality_hold_policy.merge_semantics: Canonical holds are always applied before strict-label eligibility; each held source ID is rejected regardless of annotation match.
